ball_by_ball_data.csv.description: One row per ball: Cricsheet's ball-by-ball data with player columns.

columns.name: match_id
columns.description: Cricsheet match id. Joins to matches.csv.

columns.name: season
columns.description: Season label as Cricsheet gives it, for example 2007/08.

columns.name: start_date
columns.description: First day of the match.

columns.name: innings
columns.description: The innings of the match, in the order they were batted. A Test has up to 4. A limited overs match has 1 and 2, and a Super Over adds 3 and 4, then 5 to 8 if it is tied again.

columns.name: delivery_number
columns.description: Position of the delivery in its innings: 1 for the first, 2 for the next, and so on, with wides and no balls counted. With match_id and innings it identifies a delivery. It joins cricinfo_tracking.csv.

columns.name: over
columns.description: Over number, counted from 0, so 0 is the first over.

columns.name: ball_in_over
columns.description: Position of the delivery in its over, counting every delivery, so it can pass 6 when the over has wides or no balls. With over it identifies a delivery within an innings.

columns.name: scorecard_ball
columns.description: The ball as a scorecard numbers it, as over.ball. The legal deliveries are numbered 1, 2, 3 and so on in order (6 in a normal over), and a wide or no ball has the number of the legal ball that replaces it, so it is not unique. Among legal deliveries it is. This is Cricsheet's actual_delivery.

columns.name: is_legal_delivery
columns.description: True unless the delivery is a wide or a no ball. Byes and leg byes are legal. The wides and noballs columns are blank when there is none, so use this instead of comparing them with 0.

columns.name: batting_team
columns.description: Team batting in this innings.

columns.name: bowling_team
columns.description: Team in the field in this innings.

columns.name: striker
columns.description: Batter facing the ball, named as Cricsheet writes it.

columns.name: striker_id
columns.description: Cricsheet player id of the striker. Joins to players.csv player_id.

columns.name: non_striker
columns.description: Batter at the other end.

columns.name: bowler
columns.description: Bowler, named as Cricsheet writes it.

columns.name: bowler_id
columns.description: Cricsheet player id of the bowler. Joins to players.csv player_id.

columns.name: runs_off_bat
columns.description: Runs the batter scored off the bat on this ball. Extras are not included, so the runs the team gets on the ball are runs_off_bat plus extras. A no ball can still have runs off the bat.

columns.name: extras
columns.description: Runs from extras on this ball: wides, noballs, byes, legbyes and penalty added together.

columns.name: wides
columns.description: Runs from a wide on this ball, including the wide's own run and any runs taken or a boundary on top of it. Blank when the ball was not a wide.

columns.name: noballs
columns.description: The run for the no ball itself, normally 1. Runs the batter scores off a no ball are in runs_off_bat. Blank when the ball was not a no ball.

columns.name: byes
columns.description: Byes on this ball: runs taken when the ball passed the batter and the keeper. They are not credited to the batter. Blank when there is none.

columns.name: legbyes
columns.description: Leg byes on this ball: runs taken after the ball hit the batter's body and not the bat. They are not credited to the batter. Blank when there is none.

columns.name: penalty
columns.description: Penalty runs awarded to a side on this ball, usually 5. Blank when there is none.

columns.name: wicket_type
columns.description: How the batter left the innings, for example caught, bowled, lbw or run out. It also holds retirements (retired hurt, retired out, retired not out), which are not dismissals by the bowling side.

columns.name: player_dismissed
columns.description: The batter whose innings ended on this ball. It can be the non striker, for example in a run out.

columns.name: other_wicket_type
columns.description: How a second batter left the innings on the same ball, which is rare.

columns.name: other_player_dismissed
columns.description: The second batter who left the innings on that ball.

columns.name: wicket
columns.description: 1 if a batter's innings ended on this ball, for any reason in wicket_type. That includes retired hurt and retired out, so filter on wicket_type to count only dismissals.

columns.name: striker balls faced
columns.description: The striker's balls faced so far in this innings. A wide does not count and a no ball does. It starts again at 0 in each innings.

columns.name: total striker runs
columns.description: The striker's runs off the bat so far in this innings. It starts again at 0 in each innings.

columns.name: player out runs
columns.description: Runs the batter had scored in this innings when their innings ended, on that ball. Blank on other balls.

columns.name: player out balls faced
columns.description: Balls the batter had faced in this innings when their innings ended, on that ball. A wide does not count. Blank on other balls.

columns.name: gender
columns.description: male or female.

columns.name: event
columns.description: Competition name, for example Indian Premier League.

columns.name: format
columns.description: TEST, ODI or T20. The Hundred is listed as T20.

columns.name: type
columns.description: Intl for internationals, or Fran(league) for a franchise league, for example Fran(IPL).

columns.name: country_striker
columns.description: The striker's country, from the Cricinfo profile.

columns.name: batting style_striker
columns.description: The striker's batting style.

columns.name: bowling style_striker
columns.description: The striker's bowling style.

columns.name: playing role_striker
columns.description: The striker's playing role.

columns.name: striker_age
columns.description: The striker's age in whole years on the first day of the match. Dates of birth are not published.

columns.name: country_bowler
columns.description: The bowler's country, from the Cricinfo profile.

columns.name: batting style_bowler
columns.description: The bowler's batting style.

columns.name: bowling style_bowler
columns.description: The bowler's bowling style.
allowed_values: left-arm medium, slow left-arm orthodox, left-arm wrist-spin
right-arm fast-medium, right-arm offbreak, legbreak googly
right-arm medium, right-arm offbreak, slow left-arm orthodox
slow left-arm orthodox, slow left-arm orthodox

columns.name: playing role_bowler
columns.description: The bowler's playing role.

columns.name: bowler_age
columns.description: The bowler's age in whole years on the first day of the match.

columns.name: fielder_1
columns.description: The first listed fielder of the ball's first wicket: the catcher, the keeper on a stumping, or the first fielder named on a run out. Empty when no fielder is involved, or when Cricsheet records only that a substitute fielded. wicket_fielders.csv has every fielder.

columns.name: fielder_1_id
columns.description: Cricsheet id of fielder_1. Joins to players.csv player_id when that player has batted or bowled.

columns.name: fielder_1_substitute
columns.description: True if the first listed fielder was a substitute fielder.

columns.name: non_boundary
columns.description: True for a four or six off the bat that was run and not hit to the boundary, which Cricsheet marks. A four or six with this False reached the boundary.

cricinfo_tracking.csv.description: Cricinfo tracking for the balls that have it: line, length, shot, wagon wheel, win probability. Join on match_id, innings and delivery_number.

columns.name: match_id
columns.description: Cricsheet match id. Part of the key.

columns.name: innings
columns.description: Innings of the match, numbered as in ball_by_ball_data.csv. Part of the key.

columns.name: delivery_number
columns.description: Delivery within the innings. Part of the key, same meaning as in ball_by_ball_data.csv.

columns.name: ball_line
columns.description: Cricinfo's line: outside offstump, wide outside offstump, on the stumps, down leg or wide down leg.

columns.name: ball_length
columns.description: Cricinfo's length: full toss, yorker, full, good length, short of a good length or short.

columns.name: shot_played
columns.description: Cricinfo's shot name, for example cover drive, flick, defended or left alone. Names before 2014 are coarser.

columns.name: shot_control
columns.description: in control or not in control.

columns.name: wagon_x
columns.description: Cricinfo's wagon wheel x coordinate for where the ball went, about 0 to 363.

columns.name: wagon_y
columns.description: Cricinfo's wagon wheel y coordinate.

columns.name: wagon_zone
columns.description: Cricinfo's wagon wheel zone, 1 to 8.

columns.name: wagon_angle
columns.description: Angle of the shot in degrees, 0 to 360, with 0 straight behind the batter. Left-handers are mirrored.

columns.name: wagon_distance
columns.description: Fraction of the way to the boundary from the centre of the field. Can be above 1.

columns.name: wagon_in_ring
columns.description: True if the shot ended inside the 30 yard circle.

columns.name: shot_direction
columns.description: The zone as a name: fine leg, square leg, mid wicket, mid on, mid off, cover, point or third man. Left-handers are mirrored, so cover is always the off side.

columns.name: ball_timestamp
columns.description: Cricinfo's record time for the delivery, in UTC.

columns.name: win_probability
columns.description: The batting side's chance of winning at that ball, 0 to 100, in both innings.

columns.name: predicted_score
columns.description: Cricinfo's projected innings score at that ball.

columns.name: ball_events
columns.description: Reviews, dropped catches and other events Cricinfo logged on the ball.

players.csv.description: One row per player, keyed by player_id (the same value as striker_id and bowler_id).

columns.name: player_id
columns.description: Cricsheet player id. Same value as striker_id and bowler_id in the ball file.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Name as Cricsheet writes it.

columns.name: cricinfo_id
columns.description: The player's Cricinfo profile id.

columns.name: full name
columns.description: Full name from the Cricinfo profile.

columns.name: gender
columns.description: male or female.

columns.name: country
columns.description: Country the player represents.

columns.name: batting style
columns.description: Batting style, for example Right hand Bat.

columns.name: bowling style
columns.description: Bowling style, for example Right arm Medium fast.

columns.name: playing role
columns.description: Playing role, for example Top order Batter or Allrounder.

columns.name: fielding style
columns.description: In practice only wicketkeeper.

columns.name: first international year
columns.description: Year of the player's first international match, from Cricinfo's career span.

columns.name: last international year
columns.description: Year of the player's last international match.

columns.name: major teams
columns.description: Teams the player is known for, separated by commas.

columns.name: image url
columns.description: Cricinfo's profile picture address.

matches.csv.description: One row per match, keyed by match_id.

columns.name: match_id
columns.description: Cricsheet match id. Joins to the other files.

columns.name: season
columns.description: Season label as Cricsheet gives it.

columns.name: start_date
columns.description: First day of the match.

columns.name: gender
columns.description: male or female.

columns.name: event
columns.description: Competition name.

columns.name: format
columns.description: TEST, ODI or T20. The Hundred is listed as T20.

columns.name: type
columns.description: Intl or Fran(league).

columns.name: venue
columns.description: Ground and city.

columns.name: match_number
columns.description: Match number within the competition, where Cricsheet has one.

columns.name: toss_winner
columns.description: Team that won the toss.

columns.name: toss_decision
columns.description: bat or field.

columns.name: player_of_match
columns.description: Player of the match.

columns.name: player_of_match_2
columns.description: A second player of the match, where two were named.

columns.name: winner
columns.description: Winning team.

columns.name: winner_runs
columns.description: Margin in runs, if the winner won by runs.

columns.name: winner_wickets
columns.description: Margin in wickets, if the winner won by wickets.

columns.name: outcome
columns.description: Result when there is no winner: draw, tie or no result.

columns.name: team_1
columns.description: The first of the two teams, in the order Cricsheet lists them. It does not mean the home team.

columns.name: team_2
columns.description: The second of the two teams, in Cricsheet's order.

columns.name: city
columns.description: City of the ground, where Cricsheet records it.

columns.name: end_date
columns.description: Last day of the match. The same as start_date for a one day match.

columns.name: scheduled_overs
columns.description: Overs each innings was scheduled for, such as 20 or 50. Empty for Tests.

columns.name: balls_per_over
columns.description: Balls in an over, normally 6, and 5 in some matches such as The Hundred.

columns.name: match_type_number
columns.description: The number of the match among all Tests, ODIs or T20Is, for internationals.

columns.name: collection
columns.description: The Cricsheet collection the match comes from: tests, odis, t20s, ipl, wpl, bbl, wbb, cpl, psl, sat, ilt, hnd, mlc, lpl or bpl.

columns.name: result_method
columns.description: The method that decided the result when one was used: D/L, or Awarded.

columns.name: eliminator
columns.description: The team that won the super over or the bowl out that settled a tie.

columns.name: umpire_1
columns.description: The first on-field umpire. match_people.csv has every official.

columns.name: umpire_2
columns.description: The second on-field umpire.

columns.name: tv_umpire
columns.description: The first TV umpire.

columns.name: match_referee
columns.description: The match referee.

columns.name: won_by_innings
columns.description: True if the match was won by an innings. winner_runs then holds the runs of the margin.

columns.name: cricsheet_created
columns.description: The date Cricsheet created this match's record. It is not the date of the match.

columns.name: cricsheet_revision
columns.description: Cricsheet's revision number of the match record. It rises when the record is corrected.

columns.name: cricsheet_data_version
columns.description: The version of Cricsheet's data format the match record is written in.

columns.name: event_group
columns.description: The group of the event the match belongs to, such as A or B, where Cricsheet has one.

columns.name: event_sub_name
columns.description: The sub-division of the event, where Cricsheet has one.

columns.name: event_stage
columns.description: The stage of the event, such as Final or Semi Final, where Cricsheet has one.

columns.name: archive

columns.name: year

columns.name: match_id

columns.name: captured

columns.name: no_commentary

columns.name: ball_line

columns.name: shot_played

columns.name: shot_control
columns.description: Number of balls in the match with shot_control filled in cricinfo_tracking.csv.

columns.name: wagon_x
columns.description: Number of balls in the match with wagon_x filled in cricinfo_tracking.csv.

columns.name: wagon_zone
columns.description: Number of balls in the match with wagon_zone filled in cricinfo_tracking.csv.

columns.name: wagon_angle
columns.description: Number of balls in the match with wagon_angle filled in cricinfo_tracking.csv.

columns.name: wagon_distance
columns.description: Number of balls in the match with wagon_distance filled in cricinfo_tracking.csv.

columns.name: wagon_in_ring
columns.description: Number of balls in the match with wagon_in_ring filled in cricinfo_tracking.csv.

columns.name: shot_direction
columns.description: Number of balls in the match with shot_direction filled in cricinfo_tracking.csv.

columns.name: ball_timestamp
columns.description: Number of balls in the match with ball_timestamp filled in cricinfo_tracking.csv.

columns.name: win_probability
columns.description: Number of balls in the match with win_probability filled in cricinfo_tracking.csv.

columns.name: predicted_score
columns.description: Number of balls in the match with predicted_score filled in cricinfo_tracking.csv.

columns.name: ball_events
columns.description: Number of balls in the match with ball_events filled in cricinfo_tracking.csv.

cricinfo_text_predictions.csv.description: Predicted line, length, shot and direction, each with a confidence, for balls that have commentary text but no Cricinfo value. Join on match_id, innings and delivery_number.

columns.name: match_id
columns.description: Cricsheet match id. Part of the key.

columns.name: innings
columns.description: Innings of the match, numbered as in ball_by_ball_data.csv. Part of the key.

columns.name: delivery_number
columns.description: Delivery within the innings. Part of the key.

columns.name: line
columns.description: Predicted line, always one of Cricinfo's own labels. Empty where Cricinfo has a value or the commentary gives no reading.

columns.name: line_confidence
columns.description: Probability from 0 to 1 that the predicted line matches what Cricinfo would have recorded. Checked on matches the model never saw.

columns.name: line_explicit
columns.description: 1 if the commentary text contains words that point to this line, 0 if the model inferred it from the wider text and context.

columns.name: length
columns.description: Predicted length, always one of Cricinfo's own labels. Empty where Cricinfo has a value or the commentary gives no reading.

columns.name: length_confidence
columns.description: Probability from 0 to 1 that the predicted length matches what Cricinfo would have recorded. Checked on matches the model never saw.

columns.name: length_explicit
columns.description: 1 if the commentary text contains words that point to this length, 0 if the model inferred it from the wider text and context.

columns.name: shot
columns.description: Predicted shot, always one of Cricinfo's own labels. Empty where Cricinfo has a value or the commentary gives no reading.
allowed_values: off side drive on back foot
off side drive on front foot
on side drive on back foot
on side drive on front foot

columns.name: shot_confidence
columns.description: Probability from 0 to 1 that the predicted shot matches what Cricinfo would have recorded. Checked on matches the model never saw.

columns.name: shot_explicit
columns.description: 1 if the commentary text contains words that point to this shot, 0 if the model inferred it from the wider text and context.

columns.name: direction
columns.description: Predicted shot direction, always one of Cricinfo's own labels. Empty where Cricinfo has a value or the commentary gives no reading.

columns.name: direction_confidence
columns.description: Probability from 0 to 1 that the predicted shot direction matches what Cricinfo would have recorded. Checked on matches the model never saw.

columns.name: direction_explicit
columns.description: 1 if the commentary text contains words that point to this shot direction, 0 if the model inferred it from the wider text and context.

wickets.csv.description: Every wicket of every delivery, including the second and later wickets the ball file cannot hold. Join on match_id, innings and delivery_number.

columns.name: match_id
columns.description: Cricsheet match id. Part of the key.

columns.name: innings
columns.description: Innings of the match, numbered as in ball_by_ball_data.csv. Part of the key.

columns.name: delivery_number
columns.description: Delivery within the innings, numbered as in ball_by_ball_data.csv. Part of the key.

columns.name: wicket_number
columns.description: Position of the wicket in Cricsheet's list for the delivery, from 1. Almost every delivery has one. Wicket 1 is player_dismissed and wicket 2 is other_player_dismissed in the ball file. Part of the key.

columns.name: player_dismissed
columns.description: The batter whose innings ended, spelled as in the ball file.

columns.name: player_dismissed_id
columns.description: Cricsheet id of that batter.

columns.name: wicket_type
columns.description: How the innings ended: caught, bowled, lbw, run out, stumped and a few rare kinds. It also holds retirements, which are not dismissals by the bowling side.

wicket_fielders.csv.description: The fielders of each wicket: the catcher, the keeper on a stumping, the fielders in a run out. Join on the wicket key in wickets.csv.

columns.name: match_id
columns.description: Cricsheet match id. Part of the key.

columns.name: innings
columns.description: Innings of the match. Part of the key.

columns.name: delivery_number
columns.description: Delivery within the innings. Part of the key.

columns.name: wicket_number
columns.description: The wicket of the delivery, as in wickets.csv. Part of the key.

columns.name: fielder_number
columns.description: Position of the fielder in Cricsheet's list for the wicket, from 1. Part of the key.

columns.name: fielder
columns.description: The fielder, spelled as in the ball file. Empty when Cricsheet records only that a substitute fielded.

columns.name: fielder_id
columns.description: Cricsheet id of the fielder.

columns.name: substitute
columns.description: True if the fielder was a substitute.

match_people.csv.description: The players of each side and the match officials, with a role and their order in Cricsheet's lists. Join on match_id.

columns.name: match_id
columns.description: Cricsheet match id. Part of the key.

columns.name: role
columns.description: player, umpire, tv_umpire, match_referee or reserve_umpire. Part of the key.

columns.name: person_number
columns.description: Position in Cricsheet's list for that role, from 1. The players of both sides run in one sequence. Part of the key.

columns.name: team
columns.description: The team, for a player. Empty for officials.

columns.name: person
columns.description: The person, spelled as in the ball file.

columns.name: person_id
columns.description: Cricsheet id of the person. It joins to players.csv player_id only for players who have batted or bowled.

innings.csv.description: One row per innings: the batting team, the target in a chase, super over and declaration flags, and penalty runs that sit on no delivery.

columns.name: match_id
columns.description: Cricsheet match id. Part of the key.

columns.name: innings
columns.description: Innings of the match, numbered as in ball_by_ball_data.csv. Part of the key.

columns.name: batting_team
columns.description: The team batting in the innings.

columns.name: target_runs
columns.description: Runs the side had to score, in a chase. Empty in a first innings.

columns.name: target_overs
columns.description: Overs the target was set over. It can be below the scheduled overs after an interruption.

columns.name: is_super_over
columns.description: True for a super over innings.

columns.name: declared
columns.description: True if the innings was declared.

columns.name: penalty_runs_pre
columns.description: Penalty runs Cricsheet records before the innings began. They sit on no delivery, so add them to the innings total from the ball file.

columns.name: penalty_runs_post
columns.description: Penalty runs Cricsheet records after the innings ended. They also sit on no delivery.

powerplays.csv.description: The powerplays of each innings, with their start and end in the same numbering as scorecard_ball.

columns.name: match_id
columns.description: Cricsheet match id. Part of the key.

columns.name: innings
columns.description: Innings of the match. Part of the key.

columns.name: powerplay_number
columns.description: Order of the powerplay in the innings, from 1. Part of the key.

columns.name: type
columns.description: mandatory, batting or fielding.

columns.name: start_over
columns.description: Over of the first delivery of the powerplay, counted from 0 as in the ball file.

columns.name: start_ball_in_over
columns.description: Position of that delivery in its over, counting every delivery, as in the ball file. Empty when Cricsheet's listed boundary matches no single delivery.

columns.name: start_delivery_number
columns.description: delivery_number of that delivery in the ball file, to join on with match_id and innings. Empty when the boundary matches no single delivery.

columns.name: end_over
columns.description: Over of the last delivery of the powerplay.

columns.name: end_ball_in_over
columns.description: Position of that delivery in its over. Empty when the listed boundary matches no single delivery.

columns.name: end_delivery_number
columns.description: delivery_number of that delivery in the ball file. A delivery is in the powerplay when its delivery_number lies from start_delivery_number to end_delivery_number. Empty when the boundary matches no single delivery.

columns.name: start_listed
columns.description: The first boundary exactly as Cricsheet lists it, written over.position, so 5.11 is the 11th delivery of over 5. A tenth delivery reads as .1, so 5.1 can mean the 1st or the 10th.

columns.name: end_listed
columns.description: The last boundary exactly as Cricsheet lists it, in the same form.

reviews.csv.description: DRS reviews: who asked, the umpire, the batter and the outcome. Join on match_id, innings and delivery_number.

columns.name: match_id
columns.description: Cricsheet match id. Part of the key.

columns.name: innings
columns.description: Innings of the match. Part of the key.

columns.name: delivery_number
columns.description: Delivery within the innings, numbered as in the ball file. Part of the key.

columns.name: review_by
columns.description: The team that asked for the review.

columns.name: umpire
columns.description: The on-field umpire whose decision was reviewed.

columns.name: umpire_id
columns.description: Cricsheet id of that umpire.

columns.name: batter
columns.description: The batter involved.

columns.name: batter_id
columns.description: Cricsheet id of the batter.

columns.name: decision
columns.description: The outcome of the review as Cricsheet records it: upheld, struck down or technical failure.

columns.name: review_type
columns.description: Cricsheet's type of the review. Where it is given it is wicket.

columns.name: umpires_call
columns.description: True if the review ended as umpire's call.

match_replacements.csv.description: Substitutions and role changes in a match, such as concussion replacements and impact players.

columns.name: match_id
columns.description: Cricsheet match id. Part of the key.

columns.name: innings
columns.description: Innings in which the replacement was made. Part of the key.

columns.name: delivery_number
columns.description: Delivery within the innings at which it was recorded. Part of the key.

columns.name: replacement_number
columns.description: Order within that delivery, from 1. Part of the key.

columns.name: kind
columns.description: Cricsheet's kind of replacement: match for a player replaced in the match, role for a change of role.

columns.name: team
columns.description: The team, for a replacement in the match.

columns.name: role
columns.description: The role taken, for a change of role.

columns.name: player_in
columns.description: The player who came in.

columns.name: player_in_id
columns.description: Cricsheet id of that player.

columns.name: player_out
columns.description: The player who went out.

columns.name: player_out_id
columns.description: Cricsheet id of that player.

columns.name: reason
columns.description: Why: injury, impact_player, concussion_substitute, supersub and a few others.

match_missing.csv.description: What Cricsheet says it does not have for a match: powerplays by innings and type, reviews, player of the match or umpires. An absence here means the data is missing, not that nothing happened.

columns.name: match_id
columns.description: Cricsheet match id. Part of the key.

columns.name: missing_number
columns.description: Place of the item in Cricsheet's list for the match, from 1. The same powerplay type can be listed twice for an innings when two of them are missing. Part of the key.

columns.name: missing_type
columns.description: What Cricsheet says it does not have for the match: powerplays, reviews, player_of_match or umpires.

columns.name: innings
columns.description: The innings, for missing powerplays. Empty for the other kinds.

columns.name: powerplay_type
